verdict.rationale: Docs show Devin can implement features, fix bugs, and via Auto-Fix respond to CI failures and review comments iteratively (devin-docs-18, devin-docs-19), which covers lint/test-fixing workflows, and general task-taking (devin-docs-1) implies test-writing capability. However, merge-conflict resolution and dependency-update tasks are never explicitly mentioned, and community reports describe Devin adding extraneous, unremovable changes and questionable time savings, tempering reliability (devin-comm-1, devin-comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of merge-conflict resolution, dependency updates, and independent success stories confirming reliable execution of these specific tasks.
